caption: The drawing depicts a lidded urn or trophy cup rendered in pencil or graphite on a beige background. The urn is tall with a wide body, a narrow neck, and a flared base that sits on a plinth labeled "Bryan Vase." The urn's surface features decorative floral scrollwork, and in the center is an ornate medallion containing a monogram made up of intertwined letters. A large bow sits above the medallion, with flowers and leaves drooping downward along the contour of the vase. The lid is shaped with a domed top and a pointed finial. At the top left corner, there is a circular detail of the monogram enclosed in a frame, and at the lower right corner, a rectangular detail shows the decorative border labeled "Border on Cover," which is a repeating floral motif. The objects and embellishments are shaded delicately, giving the illustration depth and emphasizing the metallic appearance of the urn. The main color is the monochromatic range of pencil against a light background.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
